sloka: दिष्ट्या त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतः ।देवतानामवध्येन विजयं प्राप्तवानसि ।। ७.१.२७ ॥
transliteration: diṣṭyā tvaṁ rākṣasendreṇa dvandvayuddhamupāgataḥ ।devatānāmavadhyena vijayaṁ prāptavānasi ।। 7.1.27 ॥

translations.english: Fortunately, you engaged in a duel with the king of Rakshasas, who was invincible even to the gods, and you have achieved victory.
